patches.purpose: Keep the generic product-use gate aware of independent application assemblies while preserving the official profile boundary. Assembly runtime and source entries are checked separately, product roles are explicit, accidental default-profile mounts fail, and malformed or unknown assembly packages are rejected.

Generic trusted desktop lifecycle hooks, environment/profile overlays, namespaced bidirectional IPC, validated caller deadlines, sender checks, cancellation, credential-free structured failures, and teardown. Every renderer boot reads current Host index injections through correlated IPC with a bounded deadline and rejects Host replacement rather than reusing stale module revisions. No product protocol is embedded in Electron or Host.
Generic desktop assembly manifests select extra runtime roots, packaging resources, icons, and build steps. Development descriptors persist trusted extension settings across macOS launchers.

Typed detached Preset derivation retains Loader resolution context. A scoped asynchronous selection resolver lets extensions preserve composed capabilities, with turn-boundary checks before and after resolution. Selectable/defaultable flags hide execution snapshots from pickers and defaults. Generic selectionBase metadata associates hidden compositions with their selectable origin; the original mode controller and read-only label use it without changing Session execution identities. Unknown or unavailable compositions never display a default mode.
Generic sidebar panel headings and wide-row icon props allow additional grouped navigation through existing slots.
Retained generic HMR transport fix supports unavailable Node execution and WebSocket close/reconnect without narrowing to one desktop product.
Expose the official MCP public tool-name encoder and honor configured MCP request timeouts during connection and discovery so extensions can use the public client without product policy in Harness.

Retained generic packaging fixes explicitly install the declared Office engine, retry verified runtime downloads, cache Windows runtime dependencies, and boot the correct private Host from smoke tests.
Retained release integration supports an explicit internal Gitea feed and unsigned Windows packages without a mandatory-update policy. Signed official package behavior retains its policy checks.
Retained Windows installer qualification supports service-hosted headless runners and a separate explicit native-presentation probe.

Workspace integration registers private external-namespace packages, their compiler programs and public exports, and product assembly commands. Official runtime manifests and sources have no product dependency. Product build configuration stays package-local.

Maintained bilingual integration documentation and generated API/config/slot catalogs describe the public extension points and product-owned consumers. Generated product names are documentation data only. Persistence history acknowledges source-only message attribution without changing official Session formats.
Preserve the existing keyless SDK audit profile as a local validation fixture; it is neither an official profile nor a product runtime dependency.
Correct stale package references in maintained bilingual Agent Notes to the current Chat and Session Controller owners; preserve the recorded decisions.

Expose a generic client service to invalidate cached skill discovery after provider installation or removal, preserving Sessions and drafts. Register its browser-only catalog ownership. Product installation uses the official Skill Provider and execution flow; the bilingual decision record documents ownership and version pinning.

An ordered session-maybe Hero action slot accepts independent extension controls beside the unchanged official workspace and mode controls. Entries release independently and disappear when a task starts. The owner row wraps within narrow windows; slot declarations and catalogs document the public extension point.

The public draft initializer accepts complete semantic drafts and persists successful explicit initialization before a Session scope is released. Pending submissions refuse initialization; storage failure restores the original draft. Ordinary draft edits retain the upstream mounted persistence lifecycle.

Expose a reusable root-scoped document.preview Factory for authorized non-Session sources. Reuse native document bodies without fabricated Sessions, cancel retired reads, clear inaccessible bytes, admit Office source reads through caller-owned conversion, and preserve visible XLSX rows when optional worksheet format properties are absent.
